8752
19 10 38

October    11    38.

The Acting Consul-General for Germany,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. R.8/38/9324/38 dated September 28, 1938, and to
inform you that the West-East Trading Company, formerly
located at 220 Szechuen Road, was established by a
Hungarian named Herbert Emmerich Szanto who was the
sole proprietor and managing director. This firm
ceased functioning towards the end of June, 1938, and
Mr. Szanto left Shanghai for Europe on July 14, 1938.
He is expected to return here in the early part of 1939.

There is no confirmation of the statement
that the offices of the West-East Trading Co. have
been removed to Manila, P.I.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.

Commissioner of Police.
pages.zh:
8752
19 10 38

1938年10月11日。

致德国代理总领事，
上海。

先生，

谨此提及您1938年9月28日发出的第R.8/38/9324/38号函件，并告知您，原位于四川路220号的“West-East Trading Company”（东西贸易公司）由一名名为赫伯特·埃默里奇·桑托（Herbert Emmerich Szanto）的匈牙利人创立，其为该商号唯一业主兼总经理。该商号于1938年6月底停止运营，桑托先生已于1938年7月14日离开上海前往欧洲。预计他将于1939年初返回此地。

关于东西贸易公司办事处已迁至菲律宾群岛马尼拉的说法，并无确证。

谨致
敬礼

签署 K. M. Bourne

警务处处长

FORM NO. 3
G. 40M-1-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 11, 19 38.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY）

Subject (in full) West-East Trading Company - Communication from German
Consulate-General.

Made by D.S. Pitts Forwarded by C. Crawford

The West-East Trading Company, formerly located at
220 Szechuen Road, was established by a Hungarian Herbert
Emmerich SZANTO. It ceased functioning towards the end of
June, 1938, when Mr. Szanto was the managing director and
sole partner.

Mr. Szanto left Shanghai for Europe on July 14,
1938 in the s.s. "Conte Verde" and is expected to return in
the early part of 1939.

No information can be secured locally that would
confirm the statement that the offices of the company have
been removed to Manila, it being generally believed that the
concern now no longer exists.

D.S.
（签名：Ba...）

D.C. (Special Branch)

（左侧边缘手写批注及签名）
D.C.

主题（全称） 东西贸易公司 - 来自德国总领事馆的来函。

由 D.S. Pitts 制作 经 C. Crawford 转呈

原位于四川路220号的“West-East Trading Company”（东西贸易公司）由匈牙利人赫伯特·埃默里奇·桑托（Herbert Emmerich SZANTO）创立。该公司于1938年6月底停止运营，当时桑托先生担任总经理及唯一合伙人。

桑托先生于1938年7月14日乘坐“Conte Verde”号轮船离开上海前往欧洲，预计将于1939年初返回。

本地无法获取任何信息以证实该公司办事处已迁往马尼拉的说法，普遍看法认为该商号已不复存在。

D.S.
（签名：Ba...）

D.C. (特科)

（左侧边缘手写批注及签名）
D.C.
10月11日
P.A. 致 D.C. (特科)

Deutsches Generalkonsulat
Shanghai

R.8/38
9324/38

Shanghai, 28th September, 1938
**〔此处转录不清〕**

Sir:-

I should be much obliged if you could advise
me on the names, nationality and present whereabouts
of the partners of the West-East Trading Co., 220,
Szechuen Rd., Shanghai (P.O.B. 1063) with whom this
Consulate-General would like to get in touch with re-
gard to an alleged claim of Messrs. F. Kloeckner, K.-G.,
Koeln-Bayenthal, Germany.

I understand that the offices of the West-East
Trading Co. at No. 220 Szechuen Road have been removed
to Manila, P.I., but accurate information is lacking.
It is also learned that one of the partners or managers
is a certain Mr. S z a n t o, probably of Hungarian
nationality.

Thanking you in anticipation for your kind
assistance in this matter,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant
**〔签名〕**
Acting Consul-General for Germany.

**〔手写批注：81/52〕**

The Commissioner
of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

德国总领事馆
上海

R.8/38
9324/38

上海，1938年9月28日
**〔此处转录不清〕**

先生：

如蒙告知上海四川路220号（邮政信箱1063号）“West-East Trading Co.”（东西贸易公司）合伙人的姓名、国籍及目前下落，本人将不胜感激，本总领事馆希望就德国科隆-巴恩塔尔（Koeln-Bayenthal）F. Kloeckner, K.-G. 公司声称的债权事宜与上述人员取得联系。

据悉，位于四川路220号的东西贸易公司办事处已迁至菲律宾群岛马尼拉，但缺乏确切信息。另获悉，其中一名合伙人或经理为某位桑托（S z a n t o）先生，可能为匈牙利籍。

预先感谢您在此事上给予的善意协助，

谨致
敬礼

**〔签名〕**
德国代理总领事

**〔手写批注：81/52〕**

致
警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。
